data.synopsis:
Yi Feng transmigrates to the Immortal River Continent. Born without spiritual roots, he can only barely survive using the "essential life skills" bestowed upon him by the system. Unbeknownst to him, in the eyes of other cultivators, his strength is already god-like, and his every move affects the entire Immortal River Continent. Unaware of his surroundings, Yi Feng skillfully resolves numerous crises, bringing many exciting and hilarious scenes, and offering new opportunities and choices to the people living on this continent.

(Source: iQIYI YouTube Channel)

data.synopsis:
When college student Uyun meets the quiet and introverted TA Jinhyeong, he immediately asks him out, saying he wants to get to know him more. After just three days of dating, Jinhyeong moves in with him, and that's when he starts showing a completely different wild side. All of his BL novel and comic consumption has perverted his perception of the perfect first time with his boyfriend. He's thought of it all, from doing it in the subway to having Uyun role-play as a K-pop idol. But as weird as Jinhyeong's ideas are, Uyun doesn't entirely hate it...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Meanwhile, counterfeit money is discovered at the scene of a murder in Tokyo, prompting the Metropolitan Police Department to establish an investigation headquarters. As the unprecedented circulation of counterfeit new banknotes throws the public into confusion, Conan and Heiji head to Osaka, where the counterfeit money is believed to have been printed.

data.synopsis:
The short is set in a coastal town in Kumamoto at the tail end of summer 1996. The 10-year-old boy Minato lives a precarious life with his drunkard father. Minato's only source of strength is Ben-chan, a goddess in the form of a young girl that appeared in Benten Island. The time he spends with her are the only times where he feels like himself. But when he is about to be separated from Ben-chan due to being sent to a children's home, Minato prays to a Shiranuhi, a mysterious light floating above the sea, to grant him one wish. His wish, filled with hatred towards his father, eventually becomes a curse.

(Source: Anime News Network)

data.background: Adapted from the original anime Hana no Ko Lunlun.
data.synopsis:
Lumi, an apprentice aspiring to become a perfumer, is attacked by black mist on her way home. Guided by a black cat claiming to be a messenger of the Flower Star, she awakens the power of an antique flower key left by her ancestors and transforms into a Flower Fairy. Because the Seven-Colored Flower has withered due to dark magic, its seven petals are scattered throughout Flower City, causing strange phenomena that erode people's minds. For the safety of Flower City, Lumi, as a descendant of the Flower Fairy bloodline, shoulders the mission of purifying and collecting the seven petals, using floral magic to dispel the darkness in people's hearts, embarking on a magical girl's journey of growth. However, during this adventure, Lumi is attacked by another mysterious Flower Fairy, and the black cat beside her has an unexpected identity...

(Source: Tencent, translated)
